name: Paula Boudreau
bio: Paula Boudreau is a Canadian stage, film and television actress. She graduated from Queen's University in Kingston, Ontario, Canada, with an Honors degree in Theatre and Music.

credits.title: The Perfect Christmas Date
credits.overview: Marie accidentally swaps diaries with a stranger at speed dating. As Christmas approaches, the holiday magic helps her find the right diary, and the right man, to make her Christmas season truly unforgettable.

credits.title: Pumpkin Regatta Romance
credits.overview: When their fathers refuse to move past a disagreement, Nadine, daughter of the boat shop owner, and Ethan, a pumpkin farmer, team up to heal the feud and revive the town's Pumpkin Regatta.

credits.title: O Little Christmas Market
credits.overview: An artist's fights to saves her town's beloved Christmas market from a developer but a budding romance with the architect tied to the deal may help bring about a Christmas miracle.

credits.title: The Voices of Our Mother
credits.overview: When a family matriarch falls seriously ill, relatives gather and discover their shared ancestral ties bind them in unexpected ways.

credits.title: Dream Scenario
credits.overview: Hapless family man Paul Matthews finds his life turned upside down when millions of strangers suddenly start seeing him in their dreams. But when his nighttime appearances take a nightmarish turn, Paul is forced to navigate his newfound stardom.

credits.title: Take Me Back for Christmas
credits.overview: A Christmas wish gives Renee the successful life she’d always dreamed of. This new reality is perfect, except for one thing… she is no longer married to her husband Aaron. Now, Renee must race against the clock to win him back before Christmas Eve.

credits.title: Life with Luca
credits.overview: When their parents build a new house, Derek and Casey pay a visit to the homestead and reunite for the first time in a long time. This time, however, they are actually happy to see each other -- it's their teens who are now at odds. Karma, or something like that.

credits.title: Video Shop Tales of Terror
credits.overview: A sinister video rental store is the portal to six tales of terror. This is an anthology horror in the classic style of horror studios from the past but with a twist.

credits.title: Pumpkin Everything
credits.overview: Amy is a novelist who returns to her hometown to look after her stubborn grandfather, Tom, and his pumpkin-themed store. While there, she crosses paths with a man from her past.

credits.title: Danger Next Door
credits.overview: After a violent mugging, soon-to-be parents Robin and Ben flee the city for the idyllic countryside, a perfect place to raise their child. Unfortunately their disturbingly attentive neighbors have their own agenda for Robin and her family.

credits.title: Sugar Daddy
credits.overview: When a struggling musician can't afford her rent, she signs up for a website where rich older men pay to date younger women. Her new money-making venture sends her down a dark rabbit hole that forces her to grow up fast, shaping her music, and how she sees the world.

credits.title: Miracle in East Texas
credits.overview: Two creative con men romance widows to invest in their worthless oil well during the Great Depression. Hilarity ensues when they accidentally make the biggest oil strike in the world, pitting them against jilted lovers, angry investors and a no-nonsense judge.

credits.title: Mouthpiece
credits.overview: Based on a stage play of the same name by Amy Nostbakken and Norah Sadava, the story follows Cassandra, who is portrayed by the two women, expressing the opposing voices that exist inside the modern woman's head, during a 48-hour period as she tries to organize the affairs for her mother's funeral.

credits.title: The Prodigy
credits.overview: A mother concerned about her young son's disturbing behavior thinks something supernatural may be affecting him.

credits.title: A Song for Christmas
credits.overview: Pop superstar Adelaide Kay is so fed up with her controlling manager that she sneaks off the tour bus after their latest squabble. credits.overview: A mysterious criminal rolls into a small town planning to knock off the local bank, assuming it will go off without a hitch. credits.title: At Risk
credits.overview: Detective Win Garano is asked to reopen a twenty-year-old murder case, and soon finds himself endangered by the political ambitions of a district attorney.

credits.title: Gooby
credits.overview: Imagine if you'd had a six-foot tall monster to help you through the rough times when you were 11! Willy is terrified about moving into the family's new house. credits.title: You Might As Well Live
credits.overview: On the advice of his childhood hero, Robert R. Mutt embarks on a madcap adventure to attain the three keys to being a "somebody" - a girl, some money and a championship ring.

credits.title: An Old Fashioned Thanksgiving
credits.overview: Recently widowed Mary Bassett and her three children have hit difficult times on their farm. Suddenly, Mary’s wealthy and estranged mother Isabella comes to visit upon receiving a devious letter from the eldest daughter. credits.title: Camille
credits.overview: A twisted honeymoon adventure about a young couple on their way to Niagara Falls.

credits.title: The Good Witch
credits.overview: A mysterious woman comes in to town and inhabits the local haunted mansion, making everyone wonder if she's a witch or "The Grey Lady".

credits.title: Mr. Magorium's Wonder Emporium
credits.overview: Molly Mahoney is the awkward and insecure manager of Mr. Magorium's Wonder Emporium—the strangest, most fantastic and most wonderful toy store in the world. After Mr. Magorium bequeaths the store to her, a dark and ominous change begins to take over the once-remarkable Emporium.

credits.title: Nature of the Beast
credits.overview: Julia and Rich are about to get married, but Rich has a hairy secret. Will Julia still marry him when she finds out about the monster "inside"?

credits.title: More of Me
credits.overview: Alice is your typical modern woman, juggling her demanding roles as a mother of twins, a loving wife and a successful career woman.
